question: In which Olympics did Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore win a silver medal in shooting?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2004, Athens**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore** won the **silver medal** in the **Men's Double Trap event** at the **2004 Summer Olympics** held in **Athens, Greece**.
 
• This achievement marked a significant milestone for **Indian shooting**, as Rathore became the **first Indian shooter** to win an individual silver medal at the Olympics.
 
• The win was celebrated as a moment of pride for India, showcasing the country's potential in **international shooting sports.**
 
• Rathore’s performance inspired many young athletes in India to take up **shooting as a competitive sport**.
 
• Post his Olympic success, Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore was awarded the prestigious **Khel Ratna Award**, the highest sporting honor in India.
 
• He later went on to serve as a prominent figure in Indian politics, including holding the position of **Union Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **2000, Sydney**__

 __
 
• The **2000 Summer Olympics** were held in **Sydney, Australia**.
 
• No Indian shooter won a medal in this edition of the Olympics.
 
• However, these games were significant for India as **Karnam Malleswari** won a bronze medal in weightlifting, becoming the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal.
 
 
 
• **2008, Beijing**__
 __
 
• The **2008 Summer Olympics** in Beijing, China, were remarkable for India as **Abhinav Bindra** won a gold medal in **Men's 10m Air Rifle**, the first individual gold medal for India.
 
• However, Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore did not win any medals at this edition of the Olympics.
 
 
 
• **1996, Atlanta**__
 
 
• The **1996 Summer Olympics** were held in **Atlanta, USA**.
 
• India's notable achievement in this Olympics was **Leander Paes** winning a bronze medal in tennis, marking India's resurgence in individual Olympic events.
 
• Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore did not participate in this edition.
